contextMaxBytes: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per explicit editor-context snapshot. Oversized snapshots are rejected, not truncated.
contextMaxProblems: Maximum Problems entries per snapshot of this workspace.
description: Development preview of the DSH agent inside VS Code.
trust: DSH executes tools and loads workspace instructions. Trust the workspace before starting it.
virtual: This preview requires a local filesystem workspace.
backend: Shared uses the Desktop backend for credentials, models and conversations. Isolated retains this extension's private workspace runtime and history.
desktopHome: Desktop Harness home containing profiles/desktop. Empty discovers DSH_HOME, the development Desktop home, or ~/.dsh. Start the updated Desktop once to register its shared backend launcher.
nodePath: Node executable (22.19+ on Node 22, or Node 24+). No shell arguments.
repositoryPath: Built DSH source checkout. Empty uses the checkout recorded by the development build.
